findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call_api · Private data: token_verdict, agent_memory, agent_profile, memory_search, memory_list, dns_lookup, decode_jwt, check_password_strength, generate_password, call_api · Public sink: geocode, call_api · Destructive: token_verdict, agent_memory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: call_api · Private data: token_verdict, agent_memory, agent_profile, memory_search, memory_list, dns_lookup, decode_jwt, check_password_strength, generate_password, call_api · Public sink: geocode, call_api · Destructive: token_verdict, agent_memory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
